best_pick_ranker.description: Best Pick ranker (SPEC-5): does calibrated_probability, key_number_distance, or sweep_robustness order weekly pick quality well enough to choose the pool's one Best Pick per week?

windows.notes: 51 weeks / 748 picks / 51 top-1. sweep_robustness top-1 54.90% vs 49.33% all-pick (+5.57 pts, P+=0.7955, week-blocked [-8.36, +19.09]) clears the predeclared 0.75 screen gate and earns one opener confirmation; interval still crosses zero, hence unresolved. key_number_distance -6.19 pts (P+=0.17) and calibrated_probability -8.16 pts (P+=0.0925) both fail. Seasons previously mined by pbp_drive_bundle [2013, 2017] (rule 4 overlap, disclosed).

best_pick_ranker_opener.description: SPEC-5 confirmation arm: does sweep_robustness top-1 (the signal that cleared the [2013, 2015] screen at P+=0.7955) still rank Best Pick quality when graded at the Tuesday opener the pool uses? Player profile -- ranks the picks we actually publish.

windows.notes: 35 weeks / 456 resolved picks / 35 top-1, player profile, graded at the Tuesday opener. sweep_robustness top-1 60.0% (21/35) vs 51.32% all-pick, +8.68 pts, week-blocked [-7.00, +22.88], P+=0.865 -- clears SPEC-5's predeclared 0.75 confirmation gate. Kendall tau +0.067 (p=0.099). Sweep loop reproduced opener_pick_evaluation's weekly fit to max|diff|=0.0. Confirmed means 'cleared its predeclared gate on 35 top-1 picks', not 'established': the interval crosses zero. Window intersects the mined 2018-2025 ledger (acknowledged); inherits best_pick_ranker's spent [2013, 2015].

mod07_weak_signal_stack.description: MOD-07 weak-signal stack (SPEC-4): does stacking the surviving weak signals -- learned availability, value-weighted injuries, and three peer-reviewed opener-bias families -- onto the frozen player profile improve forced-pick accuracy against the Tuesday opener?

windows.notes: 456 paired games / 35 weeks at the Tuesday opener. Candidate (weak_stack) 53.29% vs frozen baseline (player) 51.32%, delta +1.97 pts, week-blocked [-1.10, +5.00], P+=0.8745 -- short of the predeclared 0.90 confirmation threshold, above the 0.10 close. Arms disagreed on 49 picks; candidate took 29 of them, baseline 20. Window intersects the mined 2018-2025 ledger (acknowledged at declaration); the ~130-150-look discount applies.
